4822b8e15cb2c60be17c7abc3f25f86bdb8c1511.critique: The ranking fits the request and the updated rubric. The three union calls are the soonest and best paid on the list (Nov 2 to 4, $1,496 to $2,599 a week), each with a venue and a schedule, and the reasons say they are union calls. The non-union Princess Ball keeps an open option for performers outside the union, and Roulette is the one music call. Other Equity auditions, such as Grass or Encores, are comparable but not clearly better. The Craigslist casting posts state no dates or pay and are unverified, so leaving them out is right.

638618e8701c043955313369d88f7ef00b879ab5.critique: The ranking fits the request. The two organisation-run calls with the most detail (Smack Mellon and Culture Lab LIC) lead, followed by the Harmony Blossom performance call. The Craigslist post at $400 is the only unverified listing with a stated amount and date, and the reason tells the reader to confirm it. No clearly better listing was left out; the remaining Craigslist posts state no pay or are services or band-forming ads.

814cae84765dcbd838fc9c90685dcd6893fac7d3.critique: Every ranked listing is open to a non-union NYC performer, and the first four state pay (a starting $125 per show, $200 to $800 a day, $100 per gig, a $700 stipend) with dates and locations. Roulette is the one music call and is a reasonable fifth; the Tiny Cupboard stand-up call and Culture Lab LIC are comparable rolling calls, so nothing clearly better was left out. The Equity-only auditions pay more but are limited to union members, and the Craigslist casting posts are unverified with no pay or dates, so leaving both out is right.

84ae43ae35dd4dca3abbc08c37259907da65595d.critique: The five selections match the requested disciplines and geographic union. Princeton offers a fee-free paid commission; Smack Mellon offers a stipend; Artist Vault is fee-free and broadly eligible. DiP directly serves both selected disciplines, with a clear deadline, while the final free exhibition is explicitly identified as a donation rather than artist pay. HERALBONY has an unestablished disability eligibility requirement; many alternatives charge fees or lack actionable terms. No clearly better broadly applicable candidate is omitted.

85e961fa2fbecc1c323504025e1ffdff431862d6.critique: This is the only candidate. It satisfies the implemented borough rule through its citywide tag and the discipline rule through its all-disciplines tag. The ranking correctly distinguishes citywide eligibility from a Staten Island venue and explicitly states the missing details. No extra opportunity is invented and none is omitted.

9c2fb801732d18319272470e3b550075749fa070.critique: All five are NYC open mics that welcome music or comedy, and the first is the only dated event, free through NYC Parks. The Jalopy listing has a street address, a weekly schedule and sign-up times from the venue itself. EastVille has no street address, which is a weakness, but it is daily and from an organization, so a comparable community-list mic with an address (such as SoHo Playhouse) is not clearly better. The Boston and New Jersey mics were rightly left out for an NYC artist, and the Craigslist-style copied-in mic listings state nothing beyond a date.
